features:
Features

  • Pepperoni‑flavored filling in bite-sized, golden‑baked pockets — perfect for that classic pizza taste in every poppable roll .
  • Quick and convenient cooking: ready in minutes via microwave, oven, or air fryer with easy-to-follow heating instructions .

Family and crowd-pleaser: ideal for casual gatherings, after-school snacks, game nights, or parties—versatile and easy to share .

Benefits

  • No prep, no fuss: straight from freezer to table — perfect for busy households or teens needing a fast bite .
  • Shareable snack: about 8 servings per package, making it easy to portion out for family or group events .
  • Great with dips and sides: can be paired with marinara sauce, ranch, or cheese dips, or alongside other frozen favorites like taquitos or pizza bagels .
  • Nostalgic crowd favorite: a comfort-food classic loved at sleepovers, midnight snacks, and nostalgic moments .
